properties.description:
Recorded with add_epoch because it HAPPENED: the flo2 session built PR #511 (branch kit/opencode-loop-nudge) on 2026-09-14, and this session reviewed it and integrated it into the design on Anthony's word. Sequence 496, after the opt-in incident (495).

WHAT ARRIVED. getting-started/plugins/reflow2-loop-nudge.js — an ADAPTER, not a second implementation: it translates OpenCode's plugin hooks (chat.message as SessionStart, tool.execute.after as PostToolUse, the session.idle event as Stop) into the hook-event JSON tools/loop_nudge.py already reads on stdin, and delivers whatever the script prints through experimental.chat.system.transform before the next model call. Every threshold, counter, shape match and once-only claim stays in loop_nudge.py. Installed per project into .opencode/plugins/ by reflow2_init.py and machine-wide into ~/.config/opencode/plugins/ by reflow2_install.py; tools/check_kit_manifest.py now applies the same per-harness gate the installer applies (a latent one-sided bug: an OpenCode project reported all eleven Claude commands as missing). tools/test_opencode_plugin.py drives the four hooks the way OpenCode does and asserts the nudge ARRIVES; it caught the first translation bug (reflow2_add_decision → "decision", writes counted as zero, the stop nudge never fired — a failure in the direction of silence). Reviewed here against OpenCode's source: hook names and signatures, the {plugin,plugins}/*.{ts,js} loader, the reflow2_<tool> naming and the session.idle event all match.

This is option (b) of dec:idea-the-loop-nudge-exists-for-one-harness-only — "register a per-harness equivalent wherever an event model is confirmed to exist" — delivered for OpenCode, and an ADDITION where it works under rule:mcp-and-the-graph-are-the-only-common-ground; the served surface still rests on MCP alone.

THE HONEST DIFFERENCE, from the PR: a Claude Code Stop hook blocks; an OpenCode plugin cannot, because by session.idle the turn is over — so a stop-time nudge is queued and lands at the top of the next turn. In exchange a nudge raised by a tool call lands on the very next model call, mid-turn, which Claude Code's wiring cannot do.

ADDED IN REVIEW: the server's nudge-presence check (crates/reflow2-mcp/src/nudge.rs) looked only for a Claude Code Stop hook and told an OpenCode project "no nudge is possible for this harness" — which the plugin makes false. It now recognises the plugin file, per project or machine-wide, and reports installed. The new CI gate is listed in AGENTS.md's block, which the lint requires.

WHAT DID NOT ARRIVE: the plugin finds loop_nudge.py by convention (an env var, the machine kit at ~/.local/share/reflow2/kit, or a checkout beside it); a machine where none of those holds gets a silent plugin, which the file says of itself. Grok Build and Copilot still have no trigger.
properties.name: ARRIVED 2026-09-14 — the coherence loop gets a trigger on OpenCode: a plugin adapter feeds OpenCode's hooks to loop_nudge.py, installed per project and machine-wide, and the server's own nudge-presence check learns to see it
